stories.title: Verdachte bekent aanranding en mishandeling van vijf vrouwen bij Delft

en.title: Suspect admits assault and abuse of five women near Delft
en.summary: A 19-year-old man arrested on suspicion of multiple assaults and abuse incidents near Delft has confessed. He is accused of pulling five women off their bicycles since July.

stories.title: Verdachte bekent reeks aanrandingen en mishandelingen Delft

en.title: Suspect confesses to series of assaults and abuse in Delft
en.summary: A 19-year-old man has admitted to five incidents of assault and abuse in the Delft area. DNA evidence was also found linking him to the crimes.

stories.title: Premier Jetten wil komende weken verder praten over wensen oppositie

en.title: Premier Jetten wants to continue talks with opposition in coming weeks
en.summary: Premier Rob Jetten of the minority government plans to continue negotiations toward a broad political agreement on next year's budget and tax plan despite current challenges.

stories.title: Patiënt overleden die westnijlvirus kreeg via bloedtransfusie, verband onduidelijk

en.title: Patient dies after contracting West Nile virus through blood transfusion, connection unclear
en.summary: A patient who contracted West Nile virus via blood transfusion has died, though the precise connection between the virus and the death remains uncertain.

stories.title: Belangrijkste brug naar Maasvlakte nog weken grotendeels dicht, verkeer alleen over vluchtstrook

en.title: Main bridge to Maasvlakte largely closed for weeks, traffic only on emergency lane
en.summary: A major bridge providing access to Maasvlakte will remain mostly closed for several weeks, with traffic restricted to the emergency lane.

stories.title: Vierde dode na besmetting westnijlvirus, patiënt besmet door bloedtransfusie

en.title: Fourth death from West Nile virus infection, patient infected through blood transfusion
en.summary: The Netherlands has recorded a fourth death linked to West Nile virus in a person who contracted the infection through a blood transfusion from a donor who was unknowingly infected.

stories.title: Jetten probeert Klaver over de streep te trekken: over bezuinigingen op WIA en WW valt te praten

en.title: Jetten attempts to persuade Klaver: cuts to WIA and WW are negotiable
en.summary: A political figure is seeking to convince another to support discussions regarding reductions to two Dutch social security benefit programs.

stories.title: Colombiaanse politie pakt verdachte op voor betrokkenheid bij dood Nederlandse

en.title: Colombian police arrest suspect in connection with death of Dutch woman
en.summary: Colombian authorities have arrested a Venezuelan man suspected in the death of a 41-year-old Dutch woman whose body was found in a Colombian lake in May.

stories.title: Verkeer Suurhoffbrug tot acht weken over vluchtstrook door scheuren in constructie

en.title: Suurhoffbrug A15 traffic diverted to emergency lane for six to eight weeks due to structural cracks
en.summary: Traffic on the A15 toward Maasvlakte will use the emergency lane for six to eight weeks after cracks were found in the main supports of the western Suurhoffbrug. The 1974-built section has been closed to regular traffic due to safety concerns.

stories.title: Persoon die via bloedtransfusie besmet raakte met westnijlvirus overleden

en.title: Person who contracted West Nile virus through blood transfusion has died
en.summary: A person infected with West Nile virus via blood transfusion has died, bringing the total confirmed deaths to four. Health authorities note it remains unclear whether the virus caused the death.

stories.title: Verdachte opgepakt voor betrokkenheid bij dood Nederlandse vrouw in Colombia

en.title: Suspect arrested for involvement in death of Dutch woman in Colombia
en.summary: Colombian police have arrested a suspect in connection with the death of 41-year-old Dutch national Marlies Genz, as confirmed by family representatives.

stories.title: Verkeer A15 moet zeker maand over vluchtstrook vanwege scheuren in brug

en.title: A15 traffic must use emergency lane for at least one month due to bridge damage
en.summary: Traffic on the A15 toward Maasvlakte will use the emergency lane for four to eight weeks following the discovery of cracks in the western Suurhoffbrug.
